title: Source-guided regional anatomy
sourceAttribution: Brunet et al. / ESRF Human Organ Atlas
registration: Endpoints match original s4 voxel centers [0,0,0] and [474,474,529]. Sample nearest at round(sourceNormalizedXYZ*(dimensions-1)).
rendering: Labels tint independently measured tissue density; labels must never be rendered as filled chamber contents.
method: Manually reviewed compact-LV myocardial contours are interpolated through the volume as smooth signed-distance fields. The entire compact septal wall receives LV identity under an explicit display convention. Right-heart tissue is divided using source-observed free-wall and septal tricuspid hinge curves interpolated across the heart. Actual cavity components guide atrial/outflow identities. Fixed axial chamber cutoffs and competing LV/RV nearest-cavity wall division are not used.

methodParameters.lvContourInterpolation: Periodic cubic section curves; PCHIP signed-distance interpolation between axial contours
methodParameters.annularInterpolation: Shape-preserving outer groove, free-wall and septal hinge curves across source X; bounded PCHIP interpolation through those three observations in source Y

septalDisplayConvention: The continuous compact interventricular myocardium is assigned to the LV myocardial body. RV free wall and its nonseptal trabeculated structures remain RV. The septum is shared anatomy; this color convention is not a separate septal segmentation.
validation: Source morphology and held-out tissue landmarks are reviewed in central and off-axis longitudinal planes and multiple axial levels. There is no expert reference segmentation, measured Dice score or validated fiber tractography.
limitations: Manual regional annotations, not expert ground-truth chamber, valve, myocardial-layer or vessel-lumen segmentation.
The compact interventricular septum is shared anatomy; it is colored with the LV myocardial body as an explicit display convention.
Tricuspid hinge locations are visually estimated; mitral, outflow, appendage and distal vascular boundaries remain approximate.
No muscle fiber tractography has been computed. Curves follow visible tissue morphology and continuity.
Coronary arteries, cardiac veins, separate pulmonary veins and caval veins are not individually segmented.
Do not use these regional labels for quantitative chamber volume, wall thickness, procedural or diagnostic measurements.

sourceReferences.title: Brunet et al., 2023 preprint, Figures 3 and 5

labels.name: Unclassified tissue
labels.description: Tissue outside the six regional annotations remains neutral. Coronary, cardiac venous, individual pulmonary-vein and caval identities are not separately inferred.

labels.name: Left ventricle
labels.description: Continuous LV myocardial body, including the compact interventricular septum under this display convention. The RV-facing compact-muscle edge was traced across source sections instead of dividing the wall by distance to a cavity.
labels.method: Source-guided LV myocardial-envelope contours and tricuspid hinge curves; measured-cavity tracking for basal identities.

labels.name: Right ventricle
labels.description: RV free wall, nonseptal trabeculated structures and outflow territory. The compact septal myocardium is displayed with the LV; the RA transition follows reviewed tricuspid hinge curves.
labels.method: Source-guided LV myocardial-envelope contours and tricuspid hinge curves; measured-cavity tracking for basal identities.

labels.name: Left atrium
labels.description: Collapsed left-atrial region identified from the published basal slice and followed through the source volume. Mitral, appendage and pulmonary-vein boundaries remain provisional.
labels.method: Source-guided LV myocardial-envelope contours and tricuspid hinge curves; measured-cavity tracking for basal identities.

labels.name: Right atrium
labels.description: Right-atrial wall and pectinate region above the source-guided curved tricuspid junction. Its inferior free-wall fold is retained rather than cut off at a constant scan height.
labels.method: Source-guided LV myocardial-envelope contours and tricuspid hinge curves; measured-cavity tracking for basal identities.

labels.name: Aortic outflow
labels.description: Vessel continuous with the three-sinus aortic root and LV outflow. Identity is supported by the matching published basal slice; precise root and coronary boundaries remain approximate.
labels.method: Source-guided LV myocardial-envelope contours and tricuspid hinge curves; measured-cavity tracking for basal identities.

labels.name: Pulmonary outflow
labels.description: Pulmonary trunk and outflow region adjacent to the aortic root and toward the RV. Distal branches and the valvar boundary remain approximate.
labels.method: Source-guided LV myocardial-envelope contours and tricuspid hinge curves; measured-cavity tracking for basal identities.
